* '''Playtest''' ([[IG MagnaGuard (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-igmagnaguard-20190801.gif]] ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/e26d0f17caf92a539eec936d4c615319fce9f423/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/igmagnaguard.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “Grievous is defense value +2 here. While aboard Invisible Hand, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and characters here are immune to Clash Of Sabers.”
* '''Original''' ([[IG MagnaGuard]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-igmagnaguard-20190802.gif]] ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/60afbbdd4bcd8d2abc87d577497f1e43d04f9da6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/igmagnaguard.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “Grievous is defense value +2 here. While aboard Invisible Hand, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and characters here are immune to Clash Of Sabers.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics, and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; same words.
